project_context: Noice-inspired podcast, audiobook, radio, and live audio listener retention prediction

user_id.noice_relevance: Allows session-level behavior to be linked to a listener profile.

content_type.description: Primary content format consumed by the listener.
content_type.noice_relevance: Noice offers podcasts, radio, audiobooks, live content, and video; retention patterns differ by format.

genre.noice_relevance: Genre preference captures Indonesian audio trends and improves personalization strategy.

episode_duration_minutes.description: Length of the consumed episode or content session.
episode_duration_minutes.noice_relevance: Long-form audiobooks and podcasts require different completion expectations than radio or video clips.

sessions.noice_relevance: Frequent sessions indicate stronger listening habit formation.

avg_session_duration.noice_relevance: Longer sessions indicate deeper audio consumption.

completion_rate.description: Share of content completed from 0 to 1.
completion_rate.noice_relevance: One of the strongest signals that a listener found the episode valuable.

skip_rate.description: Share of content skipped from 0 to 1.
skip_rate.noice_relevance: High skip behavior indicates poor content fit or weak listener intent.

replay_count.description: Number of repeated plays, capped from 0 to 5.
replay_count.noice_relevance: Replays suggest high interest in a segment, creator, or topic.

replay_rate.noice_relevance: Keeps replay behavior compatible with the existing model features.

next_episode_played.description: Whether the listener played the next episode.
next_episode_played.noice_relevance: A strong serial-content retention signal for podcasts and audiobooks.

creator_followed.description: Whether the listener followed the creator.
creator_followed.noice_relevance: Creator affinity is central for podcast retention and notification strategy.

liked_content.description: Whether the listener liked the content.
liked_content.noice_relevance: Explicit positive feedback improves retention targeting and recommendations.

shared_content.description: Whether the listener shared the content.
shared_content.noice_relevance: Sharing indicates advocacy and high content resonance.

commented.noice_relevance: Comments reflect community interaction and stronger attachment.

is_premium_content.noice_relevance: Premium completion can signal monetizable loyalty and subscription intent.

subscription_status.noice_relevance: Free and premium listeners respond differently to ads, content gating, and retention campaigns.

ad_completion_rate.description: Ad completion rate for free listeners; NaN for premium listeners.
ad_completion_rate.noice_relevance: Ad tolerance affects monetization and free-user experience quality.

listening_time_of_day.noice_relevance: Audio consumption often clusters around commute, evening, and night routines.

device_type.noice_relevance: Mobile-heavy usage mirrors Indonesian streaming behavior and affects notification timing.

content_variety_score.description: Approximate breadth of content categories consumed.
content_variety_score.noice_relevance: Variety helps identify exploration vs single-creator dependency.

days_since_last_session.noice_relevance: Recency is a direct churn-risk indicator.

peak_hour_activity.description: Whether activity happens during evening/night peak hours.
peak_hour_activity.noice_relevance: Helps campaign timing for audio listening routines.

returned_within_3_days.noice_relevance: Useful for highly engaged listeners and notification experiments.

returned_within_7_days.description: Primary retention target: listener returned within seven days.
returned_within_7_days.noice_relevance: A practical retention label for weekly podcast, radio, and audiobook engagement.

engaged.description: Backward-compatible engagement label retained for older pipeline components.
engaged.noice_relevance: Keeps existing training and reporting code stable during the portfolio reframing.
